capabilities: Switch view mode per note based on a frontmatter key
Set Reading View via preview or reading values
Set Live Preview via edit or live
extras: The community plugin page notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian opens every note in the same view mode, so notes meant for reading open in editing mode and vice versa.
summary: Per-note view mode switcher that reads a frontmatter key to open notes in Reading View, Source Mode, or Live Preview.
